latent.tooltip: Empty latent video — dimensions are read from its shape.

global_prompt.tooltip: Conditions the entire video. Anchors persistent characters, objects, and scene context.

local_prompts.tooltip: Ordered prompts for each temporal segment, separated by |

segment_lengths.tooltip: Comma-separated pixel space frame counts per segment. Leave empty to auto-distribute evenly.

epsilon.tooltip: Penalty decay parameter. Values below ~0.1 all produce sharp boundaries (paper default 0.001). For softer transitions, try 0.5 or higher.

relay_options.tooltip: Optional advanced per-stream tuning. Connect a Prompt Relay Advanced Options node.
